license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing as a registered nurse, represent the person as being a registered nurse, or use the title "registered nurse," the initials "R.N.," or any other title implying that the person is a registered nurse, for a fee, salary, or other consideration, or as a volunteer, without holding a current, valid license as a registered nurse under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The board of nursing shall assume and exercise all the powers and perform all the duties conferred and imposed on it by this chapter.

name.quote: The board of nursing shall assume and exercise all the powers and perform all the duties conferred and imposed on it by this chapter.

type.quote: The board shall consist of thirteen members who shall be citizens of the United States and residents of Ohio. Eight members shall be registered nurses

moral_character_required.quote: The board determines that the applicant has not committed any act that is grounds for disciplinary action under section 3123.47 or 4723.28 of the Revised Code or determines that an applicant who has committed any act that is grounds for disciplinary action under either section has made restitution or has been rehabilitated, or both.

degree_required.value: Completion of a nursing education program approved by the board or by a board of another jurisdiction that is a member of the national council of state boards of nursing
degree_required.quote: an applicant seeking a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse must successfully complete either of the following: (a) A nursing education program approved by the board under division (A) of section 4723.06 of the Revised Code; (b) A nursing education program approved by a board of another jurisdiction that is a member of the national council of state boards of nursing.

accrediting_body.value: Board of Nursing (state approval) or National Council of State Boards of Nursing member board
accrediting_body.quote: A nursing education program approved by the board under division (A) of section 4723.06 of the Revised Code

degree_level.quote: Prelicensure nursing education programs include, but are not limited to, diploma, associate degree, baccalaureate degree, master's degree, and doctor of nursing programs leading to initial licensure to practice nursing as a registered nurse and practical nurse programs leading to initial licensure to practice nursing as a licensed practical nurse.

school_approval_basis.quote: A nursing education program approved by the board under division (A) of section 4723.06 of the Revised Code

credential_pegged.quote: an applicant seeking a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse must successfully complete either of the following: (a) A nursing education program approved by the board under division (A) of section 4723.06 of the Revised Code

required.quote: The board shall grant a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse if the following conditions are met: (a) The applicant passes the examination accepted by the board under section 4723.10 of the Revised Code.

experience_source.quote: The board shall grant a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse if the following conditions are met: (a) The applicant passes the examination accepted by the board under section 4723.10 of the Revised Code.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination for Registered Nurses)
exams.notes: The board accepts all or any part of the licensure examination of the national council of state boards of nursing or any other national standardized nursing examination.
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Council of State Boards of Nursing)
exams.quote: the board of nursing shall accept all or any part of the licensure examination of the national council of state boards of nursing or any other national standardized nursing examination that the board considers to be an appropriate measure of whether a person is competent to commence practicing nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN (National Council Licensure Examination for Practical Nurses)
exams.notes: Required for licensure as a licensed practical nurse.

interval_years.quote: An active license to practice nursing as a registered nurse is subject to renewal in odd-numbered years.

required.quote: Except in the case of a first renewal after licensure by examination, to be eligible for renewal of an active license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse, each individual who holds an active license shall, in each two-year period specified by the board, complete continuing nursing education as follows: (a) For renewal of a license that was issued for a two-year renewal period, twenty-four hours of continuing nursing education

hours_per_period.quote: For renewal of a license that was issued for a two-year renewal period, twenty-four hours of continuing nursing education

period_years.quote: each individual who holds an active license shall, in each two-year period specified by the board, complete continuing nursing education

value: At least one hour directly related to the statutes and rules pertaining to the practice of nursing in Ohio
topical_requirements.quote: of the hours of continuing nursing education completed in any renewal period, at least one hour of the education must be directly related to the statutes and rules pertaining to the practice of nursing in this state.

available.quote: An application for licensure by endorsement to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse shall be submitted to the board in the form prescribed by rules of the board.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current, valid, unrestricted license or equivalent authorization from another jurisdiction, pass an equivalent examination, complete 2 contact hours of CE related to Ohio nursing statutes/rules, and pass a criminal records check. Ohio is also a member of the Nurse Licensure Compact allowing multistate licensure privileges.
requirements.quote: The board shall grant a license by endorsement to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse to an applicant who applied under division (B)(1) of this section if the following conditions are met: (a) The applicant provides evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has met the educational requirements described in division (C) of this section. (b) The examination, at the time it is successfully completed, is equivalent to the examination requirements in effect at that time for applicants who were licensed by examination in this state. (c) The board determines there is sufficient evidence that the applicant completed two contact hours of continuing education directly related to this chapter or the rules adopted under it.

exists.quote: There is hereby created within the board of nursing the advisory committee on advanced practice registered nursing.

name.value: Advisory Committee on Advanced Practice Registered Nursing
name.quote: There is hereby created within the board of nursing the advisory committee on advanced practice registered nursing.

authority.value: The committee shall advise the board regarding the practice and regulation of advanced practice registered nurses.
authority.quote: The committee shall advise the board regarding the practice and regulation of advanced practice registered nurses. The committee may also recommend to the board that an individual with expertise in an advanced practice registered nursing specialty be appointed under division (B) of this section as an additional member of the committee.

national_certification.value: National certifying organizations approved by the Board of Nursing under section 4723.46 (e.g., ANCC, AANA, AMCB, AANPCB)
national_certification.quote: Submit documentation satisfactory to the board of having passed the certification examination of a national certifying organization approved by the board under section 4723.46 of the Revised Code to examine and certify, as applicable, nurse-midwives, registered nurse anesthetists, clinical nurse specialists, or nurse practitioners

national_association.value: National League for Nursing Accrediting Committee; National Association for Practical Nurse Education and Service; American Nurses' Credentialing Center
national_association.quote: The standards may provide for approval of continuing nursing education programs and courses that have been approved by other state boards of nursing or by national accreditation systems for nursing, including, but not limited to, the American nurses' credentialing center and the national association for practical nurse education and service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a nursing license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a nursing license or dialysis technician certificate issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of authority to engage in a licensed health care occupation in Ohio or another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of authority to engage in a licensed profession or practice a health care occupation, including nursing or practice as a dialysis technician, for any reason other than a failure to renew, in Ohio or another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of nursing while license is lapsed, failed to renew, or under suspension
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of nursing or engaging in practice as a dialysis technician, having failed to renew a nursing license or dialysis technician certificate issued under this chapter, or while a nursing license or dialysis technician certificate is under suspension

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty plea to a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, a judicial finding of guilt resulting from a plea of no contest to, or a judicial finding of eligibility for a pretrial diversion or similar program or for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or guilty plea to any felony or crime involving gross immorality or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, a judicial finding of guilt resulting from a plea of no contest to, or a judicial finding of eligibility for a pretrial diversion or similar program or for intervention in lieu of conviction for, any felony or of any crime involving gross immorality or moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, giving away, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes, or conviction of violating drug laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Selling, giving away, or administering drugs or therapeutic devices for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes; or conviction of, a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, a judicial finding of guilt resulting from a plea of no contest to, or a judicial finding of eligibility for a pretrial diversion or similar program or for intervention in lieu of conviction for, violating any municipal, state, county, or federal drug law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Self-administering any dangerous drug without a legal prescription or any schedule I controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Self-administering or otherwise taking into the body any dangerous drug, as defined in section 4729.01 of the Revised Code, in any way that is not in accordance with a legal, valid prescription issued for that individual, or self-administering or otherwise taking into the body any drug that is a schedule I controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use of controlled substances, habit-forming drugs, alcohol, or other chemical substances impairing ability to provide safe care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use of controlled substances, other habit-forming drugs, or alcohol or other chemical substances to an extent that impairs the individual's ability to provide safe nursing care or safe dialysis care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable standards because of drugs, alcohol, or other chemical substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of the ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care or safe dialysis care because of the use of drugs, alcohol, or other chemical substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice because of a physical or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of the ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care or safe dialysis care because of a physical or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assaulting or causing harm to a patient or depriving a patient of means to summon assistance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assaulting or causing harm to a patient or depriving a patient of the means to summon assistance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriation or attempted misappropriation of money or anything of value in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misappropriation or attempted misappropriation of money or anything of value in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication by a probate court of being mentally ill or mentally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication by a probate court of being mentally ill or mentally incompetent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of this chapter or any rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of this chapter or any rules adopted under it

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to use universal and standard precautions established by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to use universal and standard precautions established by rules adopted under section 4723.07 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice in accordance with acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to practice in accordance with acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care or safe dialysis care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in activities that exceed the practice of nursing as defined for the license type held
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a registered nurse, engaging in activities that exceed the practice of nursing as a registered nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding and abetting a person in practicing nursing without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding and abetting a person in that person's practice of nursing without a license or practice as a dialysis technician without a certificate issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain professional boundaries with a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain professional boundaries with a patient, as specified in rules adopted under section 4723.07 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact or sexually demeaning verbal behavior with a patient (other than the nurse's spouse)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Regardless of whether the contact or verbal behavior is consensual, engaging with a patient other than the spouse of the registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or dialysis technician in any of the following: (a) Sexual contact, as defined in section 2907.01 of the Revised Code; (b) Verbal behavior that is sexually demeaning to the patient or may be reasonably interpreted by the patient as sexually demeaning.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting suicide as defined in section 3795.01 of the Revised Code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting suicide, as defined in section 3795.01 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with an investigation conducted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with an investigation conducted by the board under this chapter, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board or failure to answer truthfully a question presented by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing any drug or device to perform or induce an abortion, or otherwise performing or inducing an abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing any drug or device to perform or induce an abortion, or otherwise performing or inducing an abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements to check the drug database before prescribing opioids or benzodiazepines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with section 4723.487 of the Revised Code, unless the state board of pharmacy no longer maintains a drug database pursuant to section 4729.75 of the Revised Code

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The director of health shall license homes and establish procedures to be followed in inspecting and licensing homes.

definition_quote.value: Practice of nursing as a registered nurse means providing to individuals and groups nursing care requiring specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill derived from the principles of biological, physical, behavioral, social, and nursing sciences.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing as a registered nurse" means providing to individuals and groups nursing care requiring specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill derived from the principles of biological, physical, behavioral, social, and nursing sciences.

value: Identifying patterns of human responses to actual or potential health problems
Executing a nursing regimen through selection, performance, management, and evaluation of nursing actions
Assessing health status for the purpose of providing nursing care
Providing health counseling and health teaching
Administering medications, treatments, and executing regimens authorized by an authorized individual
Teaching, administering, supervising, delegating, and evaluating nursing practice
methods_authorized.quote: Such nursing care includes: (1) Identifying patterns of human responses to actual or potential health problems amenable to a nursing regimen; (2) Executing a nursing regimen through the selection, performance, management, and evaluation of nursing actions; (3) Assessing health status for the purpose of providing nursing care; (4) Providing health counseling and health teaching; (5) Administering medications, treatments, and executing regimens authorized by an individual who is authorized to practice in this state and is acting within the course of the individual's professional practice; (6) Teaching, administering, supervising, delegating, and evaluating nursing practice.

drug_authority.value: RNs may administer medications and treatments authorized by a licensed practitioner. APRNs designated as CNS, CNM, or CNP may prescribe and personally furnish drugs and therapeutic devices, including controlled substances (with restrictions), pursuant to a standard care arrangement with a collaborating physician or podiatrist, subject to exclusionary formulary.
drug_authority.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall not prescribe or furnish any drug or therapeutic device that is listed on the exclusionary formulary established in rules adopted under section 4723.50 of the Revised Code.

license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse and is designated as any of the following: (1) A certified registered nurse anesthetist; (2) A clinical nurse specialist; (3) A certified nurse-midwife; (4) A certified nurse practitioner.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse and is designated as any of the following: (1) A certified registered nurse anesthetist; (2) A clinical nurse specialist; (3) A certified nurse-midwife; (4) A certified nurse practitioner.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "The practice of nursing as a licensed practical nurse" means providing to individuals and groups nursing care requiring the application of basic knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, social, and nursing sciences at the direction of a registered nurse or any of the following who is authorized to practice in this state: a physician, physician assistant, dentist, podiatrist, optometrist, or chiropractor.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner may practice only in accordance with a standard care arrangement entered into with each physician or podiatrist with whom the nurse collaborates.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner may practice only in accordance with a standard care arrangement entered into with each physician or podiatrist with whom the nurse collaborates.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: This section establishes standards and conditions regarding the authority of an advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner to prescribe and personally furnish drugs and therapeutic devices under a license issued under section 4723.42 of the Revised Code.

value: Schedule II controlled substances (with restrictions — terminal illness, physician initially prescribed, 72-hour supply, or from specified facility types)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: Except as provided in division (C)(2) or (3) of this section, a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner may prescribe to a patient a schedule II controlled substance only if all of the following are the case: (a) The patient has a terminal condition... (b) A physician initially prescribed the substance for the patient. (c) The prescription is for an amount that does not exceed the amount necessary for the patient's use in a single, seventy-two-hour period.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: When prescribing for a minor, an APRN must comply with section 3719.061 of the Revised Code. APRNs must check the state drug database before prescribing opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines as part of a course of treatment, with periodic database checks every 90 days.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall comply with section 3719.061 of the Revised Code if the nurse prescribes for a minor, as defined in that section, an opioid analgesic, as defined in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Except as provided in divisions (C) and (E) of this section, an advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall comply with all of the following as conditions of prescribing a drug that is either an opioid analgesic or a benzodiazepine as part of a patient's course of treatment for a particular condition: (1) Before initially prescribing the drug, the advanced practice registered nurse or the advanced practice registered nurse's delegate shall request from the drug database a report of information related to the patient

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The director of health shall establish a state nurse aide registry listing all individuals who have done any of the following

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication aide" means an individual who holds a current, valid certificate issued under this chapter that authorizes the individual to administer medication in accordance with section 4723.67 of the Revised Code

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner who holds a license to practice nursing issued under section 4723.42 of the Revised Code may delegate to a person not otherwise authorized to administer drugs the authority to administer to a specified patient a drug

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: A person or governmental entity that employs, or contracts directly or through another person or governmental entity for the provision of services by, registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, nurses holding multistate licenses to practice registered or licensed practical nursing issued pursuant to section 4723.11 of the Revised Code, dialysis technicians, medication aides, or certified community health workers and that knows or has reason to believe that a current or former employee or person providing services under a contract who holds a license or certificate issued under this chapter engaged in conduct that would be grounds for disciplinary action by the board of nursing under this chapter or rules adopted under it shall report to the board of nursing the name of such current or former employee

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The "Nurse Licensure Compact" is hereby ratified, enacted into law, and entered into by the state of Ohio as a party to the compact with any other state that has legally joined in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical nursing issued pursuant to section 4723.11 of the Revised Code is an option for licensure in addition to a traditional license to practice as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse issued pursuant to section 4723.09 of the Revised Code.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board of nursing shall establish the safe haven program to monitor applicants and practitioners who are or may be impaired, but against whom the board has abstained from taking disciplinary action.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse who is not described in division (A) of this section may determine and pronounce an individual's death, but only if the individual's respiratory and circulatory functions are not being artificially sustained and, at the time the determination and pronouncement of death is made, the registered nurse is providing or supervising the individual's care through a hospice care program licensed under Chapter 3712. of the Revised Code or any other entity that provides palliative care.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An advanced practice registered nurse may provide telehealth services in accordance with section 4743.09 of the Revised Code. A board may require an initial in-person visit prior to prescribing a schedule II controlled substance to a new patient, but may not require this for patients receiving hospice/palliative care, medication-assisted treatment, patients with mental health conditions, or patients in emergency situations.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may provide telehealth services in accordance with section 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: "Supervision," as it pertains to a certified registered nurse anesthetist, means that the certified registered nurse anesthetist is under the direction of a podiatrist acting within the podiatrist's scope of practice in accordance with section 4731.51 of the Revised Code, a dentist acting within the dentist's scope of practice in accordance with Chapter 4715. of the Revised Code, or a physician, and, when administering anesthesia, the certified registered nurse anesthetist is in the immediate presence of the podiatrist, dentist, or physician.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall not prescribe or furnish any drug or therapeutic device that is listed on the exclusionary formulary established in rules adopted under section 4723.50 of the Revised Code.

scope__license_tiers.quote: "Registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as a registered nurse.
"Licensed practical nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as a licensed practical nurse.
"Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse

"Certified registered nurse anesthetist" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a certified registered nurse anesthetist in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

"Certified nurse practitioner" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a certified nurse practitioner in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

"Certified nurse-midwife" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a certified nurse-midwife in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

"Clinical nurse specialist" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a clinical nurse specialist in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

An individual who is listed on the registry in good standing shall be referred to as a certified nurse aide. Only individuals listed on the registry shall use the designation "certified nurse aide" or "CNA."

"Medication aide" means an individual who holds a current, valid certificate issued under this chapter that authorizes the individual to administer medication in accordance with section 4723.67 of the Revised Code
No person shall knowingly do any of the following: (B) Practice or offer to practice nursing home administration unless the person is a licensed nursing home administrator

The board may grant a nonrenewable temporary permit to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse to an applicant for a license under division (B) or (D) of this section if the board is satisfied by the evidence that the applicant holds a current, valid, and unrestricted license or equivalent authorization from another jurisdiction.

scope__aprn_role_categories.quote: "Certified nurse practitioner" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a certified nurse practitioner in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

"Certified registered nurse anesthetist" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a certified registered nurse anesthetist in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

"Certified nurse-midwife" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a certified nurse-midwife in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.

"Clinical nurse specialist" means an advanced practice registered nurse who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter and is designated as a clinical nurse specialist in accordance with section 4723.42 of the Revised Code and rules adopted by the board of nursing.
